description: Flying companion birds that provide passive skills in combat, with hatching, leveling, advancing, entry (stat modifier) systems, and hybridization breeding

key_fields.name: Display name (string_ref)
key_fields.unitid: Unit config ID for battle model

key_fields.if_advance: Whether advance is required at this level

key_fields.attr: Attribute bonuses at this advance tier
key_fields.fly_skill: Skills unlocked at this advance tier
key_fields.entry_level: Entry level cap raised by this advance

key_fields.name: Egg display name
key_fields.fly_weight: Weight array for which avian hatches
key_fields.entry_num_weight: Weight array for number of entries on hatched bird

key_fields.name: Entry display name
key_fields.passive_skill: Passive skill array granted by this entry
key_fields.home_effect: Effect when bird is in nest/home
key_fields.belong_talent: Talent group this entry belongs to
key_fields.conflict_entry: Entries that conflict with this one (cannot coexist)

additional_tables.ConfigFly_entry_num: Number of entries possible per avian
additional_tables.ConfigFly_hybird_template: Hybrid breeding templates (note: typo in original)

process: 1. Look up ConfigFly by avian ID
a. Set baseValue from unit config (r[c.key])
notes: Unlike pets, avians do NOT inherit player ATK or HP
Avian attributes come directly from their unit config
Fixed idleIndex=8 means avians always occupy position 8

fly_skill_type.description: Avian skills are stored as type 5 in the skill type enum

fly_special.description: Special ability ID on the avian config. Non-empty fly_special means the bird has an activatable special ability

passive_skill_loading.description: FlyPet skills are stored in a separate flyPetPassiveSkillList on the player unit

advance_skills.description: Skills unlocked through ConfigFly_advance.fly_skill at each advance tier

entry_skills.description: Passive skills from entries (ConfigFly_entry.passive_skill and special_effect)

breeding_system.description: Two avians can be hybridized to produce offspring
process: 2. Look up hybrid template from ConfigFly_hybrid
3. Use fly_weight array to determine offspring species
5. Result inherits entries based on parent entries and template rules

hatching_system.description: Avians are obtained by hatching eggs
process: 3. entry_num_weight determines how many entries the hatched bird gets
